itinerary.title: Medieval Splendor of Polonnaruwa by Bicycle
itinerary.desc: Cycle along tree-lined shaded avenues through the 12th-century medieval capital of Polonnaruwa. Gaze at the masterfully carved granite Buddha statues of Gal Vihara and the Royal Palace of King Parakramabahu.

itinerary.title: Dambulla Golden Caves to Royal Mountain Capital Kandy
itinerary.desc: Explore Dambulla's cave temple sanctuaries before winding into the misty hills of Kandy. In the evening, observe sacred drumming rituals during the public veneration at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Peradeniya Royal Gardens & Scenic Transit to Colombo
itinerary.desc: Stroll through the world-renowned Peradeniya Botanical Gardens with its famed orchid pavilion. Transfer to Colombo for an evening heritage driving tour and fine dining.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sacred Ceylon
itinerary.desc: Enjoy breakfast, last-minute artisanal shopping, and a comfortable private transfer to the international airport for your flight home.

itinerary.desc: Visit Divurumpola Temple, where Sita Devi underwent the Agni Pariksha to prove her chastity. Visit Gayathri Peedam, where King Ravana’s son Meghanath performed penance.

itinerary.desc: Drive down to Colombo. Visit the historic Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara, where Vibhishana was crowned King of Lanka by Lakshmana after Ravana's defeat.
